name: V-2 Rocket
description: The V-2 rocket, developed by Germany during World War II, becomes the world's first long-range guided ballistic missile.

name: Operation Paperclip
description: The United States secretly recruits German scientists, including Wernher von Braun, who played a key role in the development of the V-2 rocket.

name: Jet Propulsion Laboratory
description: Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is established by the US Army to develop guided missile technology.

name: Soviet Union's R-1 Rocket
description: The Soviet Union successfully tests its first guided ballistic missile, the R-1 rocket.

name: NACA Established
description: The National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics (NACA) is established in the United States to conduct aerospace research.

name: Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM)
description: Both the United States and the Soviet Union develop Intercontinental Ballistic Missiles (ICBMs) capable of delivering nuclear warheads.

name: Explorer 1
description: The United States successfully launches Explorer 1, the first American satellite, into orbit.

name: Sputnik 1
description: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik 1, the world's first artificial satellite, marking the beginning of the Space Age.

name: Luna 2
description: The Soviet Union's Luna 2 becomes the first human-made object to reach the Moon.

name: Mercury-Redstone 3 (Freedom 7)
description: The United States launches its first human spaceflight mission, Mercury-Redstone 3, with astronaut Alan Shepard on board.

name: Vostok 1
description: Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human to orbit the Earth aboard the Soviet spacecraft Vostok 1.

name: Telstar 1
description: Telstar 1, the world's first communication satellite, is launched into orbit by the United States.

name: Mariner 2
description: Mariner 2, an American space probe, becomes the first successful interplanetary mission, reaching Venus.

name: Lunar Orbiter Program
description: The United States launches the Lunar Orbiter missions to photograph the Moon and scout potential landing sites for the Apollo program.

name: Apollo 8
description: Apollo 8 becomes the first manned spacecraft to orbit the Moon, with astronauts Frank Borman, Jim Lovell, and William Anders on board.

name: Luna 16
description: The Soviet Union's Luna 16 successfully returns a sample of lunar soil to Earth, marking the first unmanned sample return mission.

name: Apollo 11
description: Apollo 11, commanded by Neil Armstrong, lands on the Moon, making him the first person to set foot on its surface.

name: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project
description: The United States and the Soviet Union successfully carry out the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project, docking an American and a Soviet spacecraft in orbit.

name: Viking 1
description: NASA's Viking 1 becomes the first spacecraft to land successfully on Mars.

name: Voyager 2
description: Voyager 2, launched by the United States, becomes the first spacecraft to fly by Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.

name: Space Shuttle Program
description: The United States launches the Space Shuttle program, developing reusable spacecraft for various missions.

name: Mir Space Station
description: The Soviet Union launches the Mir Space Station, which becomes the first consistently inhabited long-duration space station.

name: Hubble Space Telescope
description: NASA launches the Hubble Space Telescope, providing unprecedented views of the universe.

name: Mars Pathfinder
description: NASA's Mars Pathfinder mission successfully lands a rover, named Sojourner, on Mars, marking the first successful Mars rover mission.

name: International Space Station (ISS)
description: The United States and Russia begin construction of the International Space Station, which becomes the largest human-made structure in space.

name: Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity
description: NASA's Mars rovers Spirit and Opportunity are launched and explore the Martian surface for several years.

name: Discovery of Exoplanets
description: The Kepler Space Telescope, launched by NASA, discovers thousands of exoplanets in other star systems.

name: Mars Science Laboratory (Curiosity)
description: NASA's Mars Science Laboratory mission successfully lands the Curiosity rover on Mars, equipped with advanced scientific instruments.

name: SpaceX Dragon
description: SpaceX becomes the first privately-funded company to successfully launch and dock a spacecraft, the Dragon, to the International Space Station.

name: Rosetta Mission
description: ESA's Rosetta mission successfully orbits and lands on a comet, becoming the first mission to achieve this feat.

name: New Horizons
description: NASA's New Horizons spacecraft performs the first flyby of Pluto, providing detailed images and data of the distant dwarf planet.

name: SpaceX Falcon Heavy
description: SpaceX successfully launches the Falcon Heavy, the world's most powerful operational rocket, into space.

name: Chang'e 4
description: China's Chang'e 4 mission becomes the first to land on the far side of the Moon.

name: Artemis Program
description: NASA announces the Artemis program, aiming to return humans to the Moon by 2024 and establish a sustainable lunar presence.

name: Crew Dragon Demo-2
description: SpaceX successfully launches the Crew Dragon spacecraft with NASA astronauts on board, marking the first crewed launch from American soil since 2011.

name: Perseverance Rover
description: NASA's Perseverance rover successfully lands on Mars, equipped with advanced instruments to search for signs of past microbial life.

name: Artemis I
description: NASA plans the first launch of Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion spacecraft as part of the Artemis program.

name: James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)
description: The James Webb Space Telescope, a joint project between NASA, ESA, and CSA, is scheduled for launch, aiming to explore the cosmos in unprecedented detail.

name: Space Tourism
description: Private companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin begin offering space tourism experiences to individuals.
